simple.meaning: נָפַח (nâphach) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to puff , in various applications (literally, to inflate , blow hard , scatter , kindle , expire ; figuratively, to disesteem ).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 12 times across Genesis, Job, Isaiah, Jeremiah, Ezekiel, and 2 more, beginning at Genesis 2:7. Its meaning is built by comparing the passages where Scripture uses it.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נָפַח (H5301).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: נָפַח (nâphach) / H5301 is traced through Genesis 2:7, Job 20:26, Job 31:39, Job 41:12 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.usage: blow, breath, give up, cause to lose (life), seething, snuff.
definitions.full: H5301. naphach [ נָפַח ] verb breathe, blow ( נפוח כור Ecclus 43:4 a furnace blown upon (heated hot); Late Hebrew נָפַח id. , נְפַח ᵑ7 , Syriac ; Assyrian napâ—u , inflame , nappa—u , smith Dl HWB 474 ; Arabic ( and) blow ; Ethiopic or Di 712 ); — Qal Perfect 3feminine singular נָָֽפְחָה Jer 15:9 ; וְנָפַ֫חְתִּי Hag 1:9 ; וְנָפַחְתִּ֫י Ezek 22:21 ; Imperfect וַיִּמַּח Gen 2:7 ; Imperative feminine singular מְּחִי Ezek 37:9 ; Infinitive (לָ)פַ֫חַת 22:20 ; Perfect active נֹפֵחַ Isa 54:16 ; passive נָפוּחַ Jer 1:13 ; Job 41:12 ; — breathe, blow , חַיִּים נִשְׁמַת בְּאַמּוֺ וַיִּמַּח Gen 2:7 (J); followed by ב also Ezek 37:9 ; Isa 54:16 and Hag 1:9 blow into it (to scatter it); followed by עַלֿ : אֵשׁ עָלָיו לָפַחַת Ezek 22:20 to blow fire upon it (ore, for melting), so figurative 22:21 and I will blow upon you with ( ב ) the fire of my wrath ; ׳נ נַפְשָׁהּ Jer 15:9 she hath breathed out her life (of a mother, compare Hiph`il ); absolute נָפוּחַ סִיר Jer 1:13 a blown (i.e. well-heated, boiling) pot , compare נ ׳דּוּד Job 41:12 (simile). Pu`al Perfect נֻמָּ֑ח לֹא אֵשׁ Job 20:26 a fire not blown (by any human breath). So perhaps also Num 21:30 (reading וגו אֵשׁ ׳עַדנֻֿמַּח until fire was blown [hot] as far as Medeba), compare Di. Hiph`il Perfect 1singular חִמָּ֑חְתִּי בְּעָלֶיהָ נֶפֶשׁ Job 31:39 (or if) the life of its (the land's) owners I have caused them to breathe out ; אוֺתוֺ וְהִמַּחְתֶּם Mal 1:13 and ye have sniffed at it (in contempt).
